_note: victor_disentangle_v1 (control for the disentanglement approach: branches only, no disentangling losses). aniq_baseline_multitask_cnn with one change: the shared ResNet-50 features pass through a crop branch and a disease branch (Linear 2048 -> 256, BatchNorm, ReLU) before the heads. The two spies still train and their accuracy is logged (how much crop information z_dis holds, and disease information z_crop), but adversarial_weight 0 means they do not change the branches. So v1 vs aniq_baseline_multitask_cnn measures the branch layers alone, and later versions vs v1 measure the disentangling losses alone.
_result: Branches alone do not help on test: harmonic mean 54.4% top-1 / 87.1% top-5, vs 57.9% / 86.3% for aniq_baseline_multitask_cnn rerun on the same GPU (D0). Seen top-1 50.1% (D0 53.4%), unseen top-1 59.6% (D0 63.4%), gamma 6.5, epoch 11. Validation disagrees: v1's mean val HM was 52.8% vs D0's 51.5%, and v1 led D0 at almost every epoch (52-53% vs 50-51%), so the 3.5-point test gap is within single-seed noise until repeated with other seeds. Unseen-only diagnostic 75.6% (D0 75.2%). Uncalibrated: seen 66.1%, unseen 5.2%, HM 9.6%. Leakage measure: the crop spy reading z_dis reached 96% crop accuracy in the final fit (57% after epoch 1), and the disease spy reading z_crop 80%. Without a disentangling loss each branch carries almost all the information of the other, which confirms the entanglement this approach targets.

model._note: Backbone and dropout as aniq_baseline_multitask_cnn. z_dim: width of each branch output (z_crop, z_dis). spy_hidden: hidden width of each spy (a 2-layer MLP, so it can detect non-linear leakage, as in DANN).

disentangle._note: adversarial_weight: GRL strength (how hard the branches are pushed to fool the spies); 0 = spies only observe. adversarial_ramp: DANN schedule that raises the strength from 0 to adversarial_weight over training. decorrelation_weight: weight of the cross-correlation penalty between z_crop and z_dis; 0 = off.

loss._note: Same as aniq_baseline_multitask_cnn for the two heads (CE + label smoothing 0.1, equal weights). The spy losses are plain CE with weight 1.

optimizer._note: Same as aniq_baseline_multitask_cnn; lr_head applies to the branches, heads and spies.
